definition.featureSource: fixed rank-aligned OFI L1/L5/L10/L20 and 1/sqrt(rank)-weighted 20-level OFI from the preceding accepted sequenced book
definition.decisionAvailability: each signal is timestamped at the current book packet receivedAt; fold assignment uses this local receipt time
definition.entry: for each latency, first strictly later sequenced book whose sourceAt and receivedAt are both at or after signal receipt plus latency; the signal book is never reused as its own entry
definition.holding: fixed horizon begins at the entry book local receivedAt; exit mark requires both later sourceAt and receivedAt at or after that target
definition.top1Comparison: OFI L1 sign is compared on the exact same entry book, horizon and feature-labeled decision sample; zero signal is flat at zero return
definition.execution: one-share counterfactual YES ask-to-later-bid or bid-to-later-ask, zero fees; one tick adverse entry plus one tick adverse exit stress
definition.selection: fixed signal sign only; all fixed latency, horizon, feature, and chronological cells are emitted; no tuned thresholds or strategy selection

limitations: Entry and exit book prices are observable-price proxies, not proof that an order could be accepted or filled at that exact level.
One share is evaluated without portfolio funding, inventory constraints, queue priority, adverse selection beyond the spread, or concurrency.
Signals and horizons overlap; per-market intervals do not remove common election/race shocks and the independent event count is unknown.
This single captured session is diagnostic evidence only; it cannot establish persistent alpha or production readiness.

experiment.replayMode: offline exact frozen-prefix replay; zero API/account requests
experiment.scopeReconstruction: same frozen initial-config membership as #72; each subsequent point revalidated by the official engine book-point extractor
